SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 9948(2)
Date 6 / 11 / 40

B'Well 976/40
C.1.Misc.129/40
6

HEADQUARTERS
CRIME BRANCH
NOVEMBER 5, 40

On 10-10-40 detectives attached to C.B.H.Q. C.1.
whilst cooperating with the Japanese Gendarmerie
raided a house No.4 Lane 4n9 Amiral Bayle F.C. where
it was believed that members of a Pro Chungking Assas-
sination Group known as "Blue Shirts" were residing.
No arrests were made but a number of firearms
and a quantity of ammunition were seized. Amongst these
firearms, two Mausers 7.63 were found to have been used
in the assassination of the Supt. Tan Shao Liang
(譚紹良) subject.
Although arrests were made at other places during
the course of enquiries, none could be connected with
or give any information relative to the assassins
still at large.
The pistols seized are believed to belong to one
Wang Tsung; an active member of the Blue Shirt organi-
zation who has not yet been arrested.
Reference C.1.Misc.129/40.

（批：S.P.）
（印：INDEXED BY (S.S.) REGISTRY DATE 6/11/40）

（签名：C. T. ...）
（签名：G. Tudar ...）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. S. 登记室
S. B. D. 9948(2)
日期 1940年11月6日

静安寺 976/40
C.1.Misc.129/40
6

总部
刑事科
1940年11月5日

1940年10月10日，隶属于总部刑事科 C.1 组的侦探在与日本宪兵队合作期间，突击搜查了法租界贝当路（Amiral Bayle）4n9弄4号的一处住宅，据信主张重庆方面的暗杀团体“蓝衣社”成员居住于此。未实施逮捕，但缴获若干枪支及一批弹药。在这些枪支中，发现两支7.63毫米毛瑟手枪曾用于刺杀谭绍良（譚紹良）巡官一案。
尽管在调查过程中在其他地点实施了逮捕，但无人能与仍在逃的刺客联系起来，或提供有关他们的任何信息。
被缴获的手枪据信属于王宗（音译）所有，此人是蓝衣社组织的活跃成员，目前尚未被捕。
参见 C.1.Misc.129/40。

（批：S.P.）
（印：由 (S.S.) 登记室编入索引 日期 1940年11月6日）

（签名：C. T ____ ）

D. C. (Special Branch).
9948(C)
19 9 40

Bubbling Well 976/40 Headquarters
Transferred to C.I. Crime Branch
Misc. 129/40 Sept. 19, 40
5

Received Shan Ken Ke, number 844 from the
Japanese Gendarmerie on 17/9/40 relative to the
decision of the Court Martial held on 7/9/40, against
the man Lee Tsung Hung (羅正洪), who was handed over
to Japanese Authorities on 30/7/40 in connection with
the assassination of Supt. Tan Shao Liang.

Decision of Court Martial :-
" Death Penalty. "

Diaries respecting this decision forwarded
to Bubbling Well Station and D.B.O. "E" suggesting
that in view of this decision of the Japanese Court
Martial and conviction should be registered respecting
this offence.

Complete file, documents etc; relative to
F.I.R. 976/40 Bubbling Well transferred and filed
under Miscellaneous report 129/40 C.I.

（批：exist / of / trap）
（批：A.W.J. 19/9）

（签名）
Officer i/c D.C.C.(E).

副总监（特别课）。
9948(C)
19 9 40

静安寺 976/40 总部
转交刑事调查处 刑事科
杂项 129/40 1940年9月19日
5

于1940年9月17日收到日本宪兵队发来的山连古（音译）第844号函件，内容涉及1940年9月7日举行的军事法庭对李正洪（羅正洪）一案的判决，此人因与谭绍良巡官遇刺案有关，已于1940年7月30日移交给日本当局。

军事法庭判决：-
“死刑。”

关于此判决的日志已 forwarded 至静安寺捕房及东区副总监办公室，建议鉴于日本军事法庭的这一判决，应就此罪行登记定罪记录。

与静安寺首次报案记录 976/40 相关的完整卷宗、文件等，已移交并归档于刑事调查处杂项报告 129/40 项下。

（批：exist / of / trap）
（批：A.W.J. 19/9）

（签名）
东区刑事科主管警官。

TRANSLATION

September 17, 1940.

Shanlenko No. 844.

Major K. M. Bourne
Commissioner of Police
S.M.C.

Notification re Disposal of prisoner taken over

Sir,

I have the honour to notify you as regards the
undermentioned person whom we took over from your authorities
on 30-7-40 that he was sentenced as follows at the Court-:-
Martial held on 7-9-40.

LOO TSUNG HUNG (羅正洪), age 29, N.F.A.
-DEATH PENALTY-

I am, Sir,
Yours faithfully,

(Sealed) Saburo Miura
Provost-Marshal of the
Japanese Gendarmerie
in Shanghai.

Case No. relative to the above person
C.l. Misc. No. 129/40 vide B'Well F.I.R. 976/40.

罗正洪（LOO TSUNG HUNG），29岁，无固定职业。
-死刑-

此致，
